That's the whole plan, and the floor's already dry outside the rug — so it's just whenever you've got the minute.

Broom handle's the right instinct. Hook the hanger over it, stand back from the opening, don't lean. If it doesn't catch on the first try, leave it and try another day; it's not worth a second attempt with your arms out over a torn ceiling.

Good luck with Thursday.
